description: This file defines an interface for a semaphore used in the RT (Real-Time) context. It includes function prototypes for creating, destroying, posting, waiting, and timing out on semaphores, along with associated type definitions.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Create
methods.description: Creates an unnamed single process semaphore with an initial value of 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Post
methods.description: Increments the semaphore value by 1 and wakes up any thread waiting on the semaphore.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_GetValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of the semaphore.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_Wait
methods.description: Waits for the semaphore to become greater than 0.

methods.name: rtSemaphore_TimedWait
methods.description: Waits for the semaphore to become greater than 0 until the specified timeout.
